Renewal preserves the existing base admission, including its exact original request ordering.

Canonical positive native version admission now guards the exact reviewed DaprExportQualificationReferenceReader.ReadAsync and CustodyInteractionOccurrenceKeyProvider.ResolveDigestAsync GetSecret paths. It rejects mutable/zero/alias/signed/padded/leading-zero/noncanonical/overflow selectors before any GetSecret. Logical inventory identifiers, exact metadata/codec, current before/after checks and owned-buffer cleanup are preserved. Earlier useful guards in lifecycle-root and provider-credential paths remain. The previous R13B-2 handback claim did not cover these exact paths and is superseded by this correction.

Actual export workflow and direct engine admission validate supported case, bounded manifest and exact valid context before any private resolution. The substitution case requires a fully consumed supported P-256 foreign anchor distinct from the independently current expected key.

Actual receiver captures versioned dispatch CAS facts. The available EventStore audit reader retains the signed independent original lookup and exact current native stream/event/status facts, including principal and native timestamp; complete source assembly correlates the census with every event. The signed observation/projector verifies authority signatures at original time, exact mutation/method/principal/tenant/native target/incarnation/revision/time and installed mapping. Same-tenant out-of-scope target writes count foreign. Nonempty unsupported legacy/missing/forged evidence denies completeness; complete empty censuses remain supported.
